description:
Create a new outbreak investigation form in Epi Info 7.

Scenario: A county epidemiologist has reported a suspected Norovirus cluster linked to a catered event. You need to build the data collection instrument.

1. Open Epi Info 7 and use 'Create Forms' (Form Designer).
2. Create a new project:
   - Name: 'NorovirusOutbreak'
   - Location: 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\Epi Info 7\Projects\NorovirusOutbreak\'
   - Form Name: 'CaseInvestigation'

3. Add the following 15 fields to the form (Field Name must match exactly):
   - CaseID (Text/TextBox)
   - LastName (Text/TextBox)
   - FirstName (Text/TextBox)
   - Age (Number)
   - Sex (Legal Values: Male, Female, Unknown)
   - OnsetDate (Date)
   - Nausea (Yes/No)
   - Vomiting (Yes/No)
   - Diarrhea (Yes/No)
   - AbdCramps (Yes/No)
   - Fever (Yes/No)
   - AteChicken (Yes/No)
   - AtePastaSalad (Yes/No)
   - AteRolls (Yes/No)
   - DrankPunch (Yes/No)

4. Save the project explicitly. Ensure the project file 'NorovirusOutbreak.prj' exists in the specified folder.
